question: Why does rev 7 still print zero trades, and what +EV hunt actually creates more takes without last-window maker?

findings.result: Gamma tag 5M is live (btc-updown-5m-…). Same crypto fee 0.07, same Up/Down complete set. Rev 7 never subscribed. 7 assets × 12 windows/hour vs 4 for 15M — three times as many last-90s two-ask moments. 4H also exists; not used (longer toxic time, not more tails per hour).

At 15:12Z, 42 live 5M+15M+1H books: 41 two-ask, 1 empty winning ask. One ask_sum 0.98 (eth-updown-15m 0.72+0.26) but taker_net −0.0076 after 7% fees. mint-and-sell into bids: max net −0.012. Lowering min_edge does not create a take. Re-enabling last-window maker still toxic.

At ~129s to 5M expiry, BTC/XRP/HYPE still had both asks (0.12+0.89, 0.05+0.97, 0.05+0.98). Only doge 5m had Down asks empty. The 0.97+0.01 surf is a two-ask race on these short clocks, not a rest-state 1.01 book.

scan_limit 16 + soonest-first fills with dying 15m pennies (Gamma bestAsk 0.001–0.04, winning ask gone) and drops two-ask 15m/1h. Rank last-3-min first, mid-window pennies last, raise scan_limit to 24, fetch 5M only 15 min ahead so the next hour of 5M listings cannot drown 15M/1H.

best_bid_ask / price_change with best_ask 0 left the previous ask in cache. Hunt could pair a pulled winner with the cheap side. Clear asks/bids when the top is ≤0. Last 180s empty WS legs still HTTP-gap-fill.

Same-second BUY prints on both legs (min price in a ±2s window) look like fat underrounds. That cherry-picks independent trades, not a simultaneous two-ask book. Do not hunt from last-trade implied mids. data-api tape still shows 5M has heavy two-sided flow — reason to watch the books, not to take prints.

rev8.rank: seconds_left≤180 first; else two-ask (bestAsk not a penny); else pennies
rev8.http_flicker: empty WS ask + ≤180s left also REST-fills, 1s/slug
rev8.still: maker_window=0, min_edge=0.02, FORCE_PAPER, no live, no paper reset

honest_expectation: Rev 8 puts the engine on the clocks where two-ask tails actually appear. Rest-state ATM books stay ask_sum≥1.01 and taker_net negative. Many 5M expiries will still print zero fills when the winning ask is pulled. Dashboard tape with 5m slugs and empty_ask_legs is the tell. Do not treat no-fill windows as a hung engine, and do not re-enable maker to force trades.
